card.name: Inside MDS and MDD abbreviations
card.fires_on: The second part of capitalized abbreviations split after an M or PM, mainly DS or DD in MDS, MDD and PMDD. It also fires on the middle of some names such as Imdad or مسجد.

modes.label: MDS/MDD abbreviations
modes.description: The DS or DD piece completing myelodysplastic syndrome, major depressive disorder or PMDD.

modes.label: Middle of names
modes.description: A syllable inside a personal or place name in non-medical text.

card.plain: It marks the end of short disease abbreviations like MDS and MDD, and sometimes the middle of a foreign name.
